runtimeRules.R-FEED-ORDER: Feed section order is frozen: Flash Deals then Priority Placements then the third section. Never reorderable.
runtimeRules.R-GRACE: A claimed code is valid until the deal expires, plus a 15-minute grace period. Never a fixed countdown from claim.
runtimeRules.R-FEE-ON-VERIFIED: The KES 30 success fee is debited only on a verified redemption, and is disclosed before it is taken.
runtimeRules.R-RESOLVE-THEN-CHARGE: Resolve the code first, then charge. Never charge before the outcome is known.
runtimeRules.R-ARREARS: Redemptions continue while a merchant owes. Arrears settle automatically from the next top-up.
runtimeRules.R-VERIFY-ANYWAY: DISPUTED. The repo claim-and-till mirror documents verify-anyway: a location mismatch still redeems, dispute routes to admin review. Frames show wrong-shop as hard rejection. Unresolved — see drift D-07.
runtimeRules.R-PHONE-BEFORE-CLAIM: An email-only account is blocked at claim until a phone number is verified.
runtimeRules.R-APPROVAL-GATE: A shop stays hidden from shoppers until an admin approves it.
runtimeRules.R-REVERSAL-NOTE: A success-fee reversal is blocked without a note. Every reversal is audit-trailed.
runtimeRules.R-LEAD-LOCK: A lead is locked to one agent for a fixed attribution window.
runtimeRules.R-AGENT-NO-SUBMIT: The agent sends an onboarding link. The merchant authenticates and submits onboarding themselves.
runtimeRules.R-VERIFY-PERMISSION: Staff need verify permission to enter codes; the owner grants it in Staff.
runtimeRules.R-STRIPE-PHASE-1: Shipped top-up is Stripe Checkout (Phase 1). M-Pesa STK is pending live IntaSend credentials, so pending never means credited.
runtimeRules.R-LIVE-NODES-ONLY: Only nodes flagged live are counted in founder metrics.
runtimeRules.R-VERIFIED-REDEMPTIONS: The merchant trust and ranking signal is verified redemptions. Never stars or ratings.
runtimeRules.R-ONE-PRICE: One summed YOU PAY number, identical on tile, detail and claimed code. Extra charges are declared up front and cannot be added at the counter.
runtimeRules.R-PLAN-NAMES: Plans are Standard and Elite, never Free. Success fee KES 30, Elite KES 3,500/month, boost KES 500/24h.
runtimeRules.R-TAGLINE: Tagline is exact: Discover, Claim and Redeem.

frames.name: Verify-phone gate
frames.job: Bind a verified phone to an email-only account before the shopper can claim anything.

frames.name: Deal feed

frames.captureReadinessReason: Map pins depend on seeded geo data.

frames.name: Deal detail
frames.job: Decide whether the deal is worth it, seeing the full price before committing.
frames.captureReadinessReason: Deal content is seeded rehearsal data.

frames.captureReadinessReason: Claim history is seeded rehearsal data.

drift.what: Contract corrections found when landing the mirror in the repo
drift.detail: Landing the mirror surfaced claims that did not match the working tree. Corrected here: 8l route was /tickets (shipped route is /my-deals); 12a and 12e sourceFiles omitted the (public) route group; the smoke anchors for 13f, 8f, 8j, 13j and 13e named copy the app does not render; stateCoverage understated eleven states that already ship. Left for a founder ruling: M8 is recorded design-ahead because 'the repo create flow has no charge-disclosure step', but new-deal-wizard.tsx ships a mandatory charge-disclosure step, so either M8 becomes live or the frame describes something else.

drift.what: Agent 'Send onboarding link' has no repo backing
drift.detail: Frame 13b recorded 'Send onboarding link' as the primary action for R-AGENT-NO-SUBMIT. No such action, route, or attribution wiring exists: /merchant/onboard takes no lead parameter and there is no send path. The rule itself holds architecturally — no agent-submits-the-form path exists anywhere — but the action is unbuilt, so the frame's primaryAction now records the shipped merchant-linkage action instead. Do not build the send flow without an attribution decision.

drift.what: Admin approvals queue has no 'rejected' state
drift.detail: Frame 11a declares a rejected state, but merchants.status is CHECK-constrained to ('pending','active','suspended','churned') — there is no rejected value to query or display. Showing it needs a migration and a decision on whether a rejected shop is suspended, deleted, or a new status, so the state is left uncovered rather than faked against 'suspended'.
